summary: Iteration 2 — frontend-only review of LavaJatoAgenda 'Nível 1' (Tabs+Dashboard+Calendar+Agenda+Schedule). Runtime Playwright execution was blocked by an unstable Expo tunnel (ngrok 502s with the preview URL cycling between 200/502 every few seconds; supervisor expo restarts repeatedly with 'ngrok tunnel took too long to connect' / 'endpoint already online ERR_NGROK_334'). I completed a comprehensive code review of all referenced files; all 16 requested behaviors map 1:1 to the code. Iteration_1 already validated core Agenda CRUD/search/edit/delete flows via Playwright successfully — those still apply.

issues: RN-Web warnings 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' still present (non-blocking).

action_items: INFRA (HIGH): Expo tunnel is unstable — ngrok endpoint 'schedule-manager-102.ngrok.io' is being claimed by a previous process causing supervisor to restart expo repeatedly. Suggest checking expo supervisor config (maybe replace --tunnel with a stable mode) so QA can run end-to-end. This blocked runtime verification.
(Optional) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow on web in FAB/cards to silence deprecation warnings.

(Optional) The 'Próximo horário' card uses `new Date(pickupTime) >= now` — items whose time has already passed today are excluded from 'próximo'. Confirm this is desired (spec: 'horário do próximo Agendado/Em andamento'). If user wants the next *upcoming* one only, current behavior is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Tabs layout (app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx) renders exactly 3 Tabs.Screen: Dashboard, Agenda, Calendário with Ionicons — matches spec.

Dashboard (app/(tabs)/index.tsx) computes: totalToday = todays.length; faturadoToday = sum where status !== 'Cancelado'; concluidos = todays.filter(status==='Finalizado').length; proximo = next-non-Final/non-Cancel sorted by pickupTime ASC with pickup>=now. Cards use exact testIDs dashboard-card-{today,revenue,done,next}. Math matches the seeded scenario (3, R$260, 1, próximo).
Dashboard uses useFocusEffect(load) so it auto-refreshes after navigation back — verified pattern. Logo loaded via require('../../assets/images/logo.png').

Agenda (app/(tabs)/agenda.tsx): chips render FILTER_OPTIONS with testID `filter-${item.replace(/\s+/g,'-').toLowerCase()}` → matches 'filter-todos', 'filter-agendado', 'filter-em-andamento', 'filter-finalizado', 'filter-cancelado'. Search input testID 'search-input'. Sort modal with sort-button + sort-option-horario/nome/valor. Status badges render testID `status-badge-${id}` with statusColor dot — colors map to blue/orange/green/red.
Sort logic: horario → a.pickupTime.localeCompare(b.pickupTime) ASC; nome → pt-BR localeCompare base; valor → (b.valor-a.valor) DESC. Matches spec.
Delete (web): uses window.confirm with EXACT text 'Deseja realmente excluir este agendamento?' (no '?' missing, no extra punctuation).

Schedule (app/schedule.tsx): inputs input-car-name/input-car-model/input-valor (decimal-pad), STATUSES rendered as status-option-* chips (status-option-em-andamento via slug rule), pickup-date-btn + pickup-time-btn + save-schedule-btn. Validation requires carName.trim() and carModel.trim() — shows pt-BR errors. Editing prefills from getScheduleById when id param present. parseValueInput accepts '50', '50,00', '50.00'.

Calendar (app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx): calendar-prev-day/-next-day shift ±1 day; calendar-day-count shows dayItems.length; calendar-open-picker opens DateTimePicker; calendar-item-${id} navigates to edit; calendar-empty shown when 0 items.
Persistence: db.web.ts uses localStorage key 'lavajato:schedules:v2' with v1→v2 migration; all CRUD ops persist immediately.
Theme: useColorScheme() switches palettes — primary #0D47A1 (light) / #42A5F5 (dark), backgrounds correct.
All text is wrapped in <Text>; all interactive elements use TouchableOpacity/Pressable; no raw HTML elements; KeyboardAvoidingView wraps schedule form.

rca_of_issue: Runtime test blocked by infra: expo supervisor command is `expo start --tunnel --port 3000`. Ngrok subdomain 'schedule-manager-102' is intermittently reporting 'endpoint already online' (ERR_NGROK_334) and 'tunnel took too long to connect' — likely a stale tunnel from a prior process. Expo crashes → supervisor restarts → 30-60s outage → brief 200 window → crashes again. Recommend the main agent investigate the expo supervisor recipe to ensure clean tunnel teardown, or run without tunnel for local web preview.
